target.statement: Successful Preemption Rate (SPR) of 44.5% averaged over all 30 model-harness settings under the Default condition (Overall column, Average row of Table 1).
target.table_ref: Table 1, Overall SPR column, Average row

compute.basis: The headline 44.5% SPR is an average over 30 model-harness settings each run on 268 Docker cases (thousands of agent trajectories), and 17 of the 18 models are closed-source APIs (GPT-5.5/5.6, Claude-Sonnet-5, GLM, Qwen-Max, MiniMax) that cannot be run locally, so the full protocol is infeasible on a laptop.

blockers: Requires 17 closed-source frontier models via Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode APIs (GPT-5.5/5.6, Claude-Sonnet-5, GLM-4.7/5.2/5.3, Qwen3.8-Max, MiniMax-M3, etc.)
Thousands of agent trajectories across 268 Docker cases x 30 model-harness settings x 3 instruction conditions
Agent-as-a-Judge (Qwen3.8-27B via Claude Code) needed for DIR and concealment audits
Some cases involve GPU VRAM conflicts (10 GPU cases) and H200-class hardware in case studies
No single cheap table cell: every reported number is an aggregate over the full model-harness panel
title: ClashBench: Conflicts Leading Agents to Seize and Harm
